We have backlog. Need inspect each story. Most are simple: As a user/admin, I want to do X, optional so that... Need identify any containing extra beyond role, means, optional ends. The project "Zooniverse" stories maybe all standard. But some stories might include procedural notes? Let's inspect.

Format: role, means. "As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting." Means only, no extra. Minimal no violation.

ZO-005: "As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path." includes ends/rationale. Minimal no violation.

ZO-016: "As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image." Means and ends. minimal.
